message.reasoning_content: I'll Be Back and You Like Me Too Much are both on A Hard Day's Night. "I'll Be Back" closes the UK album. Both were first released on AHDN. Hmm—both. Pick "I'll Be Back"? Actually "You Like Me Too Much" also first released on AHDN (UK). Ambiguous; maybe question expects only one... choose "You Like Me Too Much"? Both valid. "You Won't See Me" is Help!. I'll pick "I'll Be Back" with moderate probability.
